open_findings.expected: Value-free evidence for the candidate tree: the defect reproduced before the change (db phase fails because consumer parity skips), and after the change the consumer-parity suite's pass/fail count in the db phase plus the outcome of `npm run agent -- prove COORD-VAULT-DB-001` for static, server and db. If consumer parity then fails on its assertions, say so; that is a separate finding, not a reason to widen scope.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Run prove on the candidate (it already requires gate:static; the orchestrator also runs server and db when those gates are selected, or run the db phase via the same value-free diagnostic approach), and record the counts in the commit body or a round note. No code change is expected.
open_findings.observed: The EVIDENCE check is not met. The round manifest attests only typecheck and gate:static (verify-phase static); the commit body is one line. There is no record that the db phase now runs tests/db/production-2e-consumer-parity.test.ts without skipping, nor whether the agent-side prove (static, server, db) is green for the candidate tree. Nor is the value-free reproduction of the defect, required by DEFECT, recorded. The code change is correct, but whether it actually unblocks P2 (the reason for the task) is unshown: consumer parity could still fail on its own assertions once it runs.

regression_proof.description: Round 2 manifest or commit body carries the reproduction and the db-phase consumer-parity counts.

required_manual_checks.description: Since COORD-SERVER-001 (98838b6), assertProofIsolation refuses ASCEND_VAULT_PATH in every non-server phase ('vault input is limited to server proof'), and the orchestrator builds the db environment without it (apps/os/scripts/proof-orchestrator.mjs:275). tests/db/production-2e-consumer-parity.test.ts is classified PROVEN phase db in gate-2g1.ts and is gated on ASCEND_DATABASE_URL AND ASCEND_VAULT_PATH (describeIfDb, line 59), so it always skips in the db phase and gate-proof rejects the skip. The sanctioned `prove` therefore cannot produce a green full aggregate for any tree; this blocks 2A.3a-2 precondition P2. Reproduce with a value-free diagnostic before changing anything.

Allow ASCEND_VAULT_PATH in the db phase only, sourced from the same private one-key apps/os/.env.local through the existing localVaultPath() (0600, regular file, exactly one ASCEND_VAULT_PATH line, absolute, an existing directory), passed by the orchestrator into proofEnvironment('db', { urls, pg17Bin, vaultPath }). It must remain refused in static, fixture and recovery phases. No other name is added to any phase; recovery and backup authority stay refused in db; the app/admin identity checks are unchanged. Do not reclassify production-2e-consumer-parity (it also needs ASCEND_DATABASE_URL_DIRECT, which the server phase does not receive) and do not touch gate-2g1.ts or gate-proof.mjs.

Replace the assertion at tools/agent/test/proof-orchestrator.test.mjs:50 (db + vault refused) with its intended form, and state why in the test: db accepts an absolute vault path; db refuses a relative one; static, fixture and recovery still refuse any vault path; db still refuses every ASCEND_BACKUP_*, ASCEND_RECOVERY_*, ASCEND_R1C_ROOT and ASCEND_OWNER_PASSWORD name. Add an orchestrator-level synthetic test (no database, no real vault) that the db phase receives the vault path from localVaultPath and that a missing or group-readable .env.local fails the db phase closed. Mutants: dropping the db allowance, or allowing vault in recovery, must each turn a test red.

Builder records, value-free: the db phase's consumer-parity suite no longer skips for want of the vault (pass or fail count only), and whether the full agent-side prove (static, server, db) is green for the candidate tree. Note that the db phase runs its PROVEN suites read-only against production through the sanctioned .env.production.local inputs; no write, migration or deployment is part of this task. Owner recovery (R1b/R1c) is not required here.

Diff limited to the write paths. No change to Coordinator state handling, gate classification, test suites under tests/db, or application code. After promotion, 2A.3a-2 (claimed, paused) resumes by re-running prove on its pinned tree.

title: COORD-VAULT-DB-001 Pass the private vault path to the db proof phase so the full aggregate can pass (production-2e-consumer-parity)
